game.title: Far Cry 6
game.blurb: Open-world first-person shooter set on the island of Yara, from Ubisoft Toronto with other Ubisoft studios, released 2021-10-07. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Dani Rojas joins Libertad, wins over Yara's regions and takes the island back.

chapters.title: The Guerrilla War
chapters.summary: FND bases, checkpoints, anti-aircraft guns, supply drops, Bandido operations and camps.

chapters.title: Life in Yara
chapters.summary: Yaran Stories, cockfights, races, dominoes, fishing, hunting, treasure and collectibles.

chapters.title: Special Operations
chapters.summary: The Special Operations missions, including the Mastery 3 runs.

chapters.title: Combat, Gear and Amigos
chapters.summary: Fighting tricks, weapon mods, gear sets, rides and your animal Amigos.

chapters.title: Insanity DLC: Vaas, Pagan and Joseph
chapters.summary: The three villain DLC episodes, each a run through a mind.

chapters.title: Lost Between Worlds
chapters.summary: The Lost Between Worlds expansion with Fai and the rifts.

notes: No StrategyWiki page. farcry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 213 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam store app is 2369390 (the Steam release of the game). All 99 Steam achievements are visible (none hidden). 41 of them belong to the Vaas, Pagan and Joseph Insanity DLC and the Lost Between Worlds expansion, so those get their own chapters. Recruiting the regional groups is used as the main story outline.
